title: A Companion for the Practised Healer
summary: A companion for Champions who already mend well that adds the first calling-back of a stopped heart and a wide field of mending warmth.

title: The Treatise of Restored Breath
summary: A treatise on bringing breath back to the failing and clearing what clogs it with a lasting aegis for the patient.

title: The Compendium of the Living Field
summary: A compendium for those whose qi has left the body that spreads vitality as a field and reaches the wounded at a distance.

title: The Radiant Pulse Canon
summary: A canon of the pulse of vitality that heals the near and the far and bursts outward to drive off those who press close.

title: The Azure Physicians' Treatise
summary: A treatise of the Azure Sky physicians on mending the hurt and calling back the stricken and shrugging off a tainted blow.

title: Manual of the Basin Healers
summary: A manual of healers who keep pace with a marching host and chain their mending and their blows into one flowing sequence.

title: The Two Rivers of Vitality
summary: A treatise on running one stream of vitality to heal and one to hold an enemy still while the wounded are tended.

title: The Wind-Sworn Physician's Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of the wind-sworn healers on mending quickly in the open and calling back a fallen comrade before the wind turns.

title: Treatise on the Long Breath of the Plateau
summary: A treatise on the long breath of vitality that carries a healer across rough ground and through a hard day of tending.

title: The Open Sky Renewal Canon
summary: A canon of renewal under the open sky that cleanses deep taint and brings the stricken back and mends a whole company at once.
